It adds virtual null around the main lobe to reduce the width of the main lobe, thus reducing the main lobe offset error. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the method effectively enhances the main lobe directivity.

articleTitle: Design of a 220 GHz Double Staggered Vane Traveling Wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a high-power and high-efficiency traveling wave tube amplifier is designed, using the staggered double vane slow wave structure with a pencil beam. The PIC simulation result shows that this amplifier could generate a stable power of 45 W with a gain of 29.6 dB and an efficiency of 4.74%, driven by a voltage of 23.8 kV and current of 40 mA.

articleTitle: Compact Integrated Substrate Gap Waveguide Bandpass Filter with Two Transmission Zeros
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a K-band compact fourth-order broadband bandpass filter (BPF) based on an integrated substrate gap waveguide (ISGW) is proposed. Significant size reduction is achieved through the introduction of two reversely placed split ring resonators (SRR) and two half-mode cavity resonators. At the same time, a transmission zero (TZ) is introduced on each side of the passband through cross-coupling to improve the selectivity of the filter. The periodic electromagnetic band gap (EBG) layer at the top of the structure prevents the radiation leakage caused by the engraving of SRRs. The center frequency of the filter is 22.5GHz, the 3dB fractional bandwidth is 21%, the passband insertion loss is 0.6dB, and the size is 0.67λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> * 0.67λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>.

articleTitle: Microwave Engineering for Electromagnetics Education: Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents the challenges and opportunities in the electromagnetics teaching of microwave engineering. Some typical examples are shown to promote classroom experience and optimize student learning, including the discussion of teaching strategies for enhancing electromagnetics education.

articleTitle: Design of an amplifying polarization-converting metasurface element
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a design of amplifying metasurface element with polarization conversion. The element consists of a receiving patch, a power amplifier circuit, and a re-radiating patch. It is capable of converting the incident electromagnetic (EM) waves from linear polarization to orthogonal polarization before reflection, and amplifying the reflected EM wave through the amplification circuit. We fabricate a 4 × 4 unit experimental prototype and test it in a microwave anechoic chamber. Experimental results indicate that the unit operates at the frequency of 5.73 GHz and achieves gain of 12 dB. The proposed element design holds promise for future wireless coverage enhancement scenarios.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Antenna Array with Broad Bandwidth and Flat Gain Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an array antenna with wide bandwidth for tunnels under construction. The antenna is composed of eight sequential-fed patch antenna elements and a broadband feeding network capable of power division and phase shifting. By loading rectangular branches and arc-shaped chamfer parasitic elements, the performance of circular polarization is improved. Furthermore, to reduce the diagonal cross-polarization effectively, the eight antenna elements are rotationally laid out. The proposed antenna array achieves a simulated -10 dB impedance bandwidth of 73.3% (1.32-2.85 GHz), a 3dB AR bandwidth of 65.1%(1.45-2.85 GHz), and a peak gain of 15 dBic, which justify the applicability of the proposed antenna array for tunnels under construction.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method Based on Deep Learning for Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning optimization method combining U-net model and cycle generative adversarial network (Cycle-GAN) is proposed to efficiently solve the electromagnetic inverse scattering (EMIS) problems. Firstly, a U-net model is used to obtain a rough preliminary reconstruction. Through down-sampling and up-sampling processes, the basic features of the object are extracted and reconstructed from the measured scattered field, providing a coarse dielectric parameter distribution. Then, a Cycle-GAN model further refines the output of the U-net. The Cycle-GAN model, through its adversarial training mechanism involving a generator and a discriminator, enhances the details of the preliminary reconstruction, resulting in a finely detailed dielectric parameter distribution his method improves the problem of rough results obtained by using U-net method alone, and can effectively solve and optimize EMIS problems.

articleTitle: A Physically Preprocessed CNN-Based Mutual Coupling Model for MIMO Antennas
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a CNN network incorporates antenna correlation information through physical preprocessing to address the channel capacity estimation problem for strongly coupled antenna arrays. The proposed method not only satisfies millisecond response requirements but also surpasses traditional analytical solutions and direct modelling networks in terms of prediction accuracy and dataset construction cost.

articleTitle: Non-Destructive Testing of Multi-Layer Composites Based on Microwave Time Reversal
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Microwave time reversal (MTR) is a potential nondestructive testing (NDT) technique for multi-layer composites. In our previous study, the effectiveness of MTR for small buried defect detection was investigated in two-dimensional (2D) homogeneous composites, and the localization problem caused by the strong reflection from metal was revealed first. This paper discusses the effectiveness of MTR for NDT of multi-layer composites in 2D and three-dimensional (3D) cases. The improved entropy regularization method is used to solve the localization problem by combining the information provided by the target response signal, and correct defect detection for small buried defect and extended defect is achieved. Furthermore, the multi-scale effect caused by composites and small defect leads to longer detection times in 3D cases. Message passing interface and GPU parallel computing are used to accelerate the defect detection process to achieve efficient defect detection.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Efficient Beam Steering Algorithm for Deformed Curved Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a physically driven deep learning method is proposed for the beam steering problem of deformed conformal array antenna. The loss design is carried out by three constraints: gain, main lobe direction and side lobe level (SLL), and the softmax method is chosen for the loss design in order to solve the gradient truncation problem in the neural network. The specific direction map is obtained by active element pattern (AEP) algorithm after the output amplitude and phase of the neural network. The results show that the trained neural network output performs well under three constraints, and the gain and SLL obtained by this method are better than the superior single constraint.

articleTitle: A Compact Circularly Polarized Dielectric Resonator Antenna for Millimeter-Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A single-fed millimeter-wave (mm-wave) circularly polarized (CP) dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is investigated. It is designed on the substrate using a set of concentric air and metalized grooves, giving a modified z-shaped DRA. The DRA is excited by a rectangular slot etched on the ground of a second substrate. To produce CP radiation, the DRA is inclined at 45° in the horizontal plane. It has a simulated 10-dB impedance bandwidth of 9.07% (26.7–29.2 GHz) and 3-dB AR bandwidth of 6.89% (27.0–28.9 GHz), thus obtaining a CP usable bandwidth of 6.89% (27.0–28.9 GHz). Also, the DRA has a simulated peak gain of ~8.9 dBic with a low profile of 0.06λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> (λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is the vacuum wavelength at center operating frequency).

articleTitle: Performance Parameters of Microstrip Antennas under Different Plasma Distributions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The input impedance of the antenna will change due to the plasmas around the antenna, which will lead to the change of antenna resonance point, return loss and other performance parameters. In this paper, the interaction model between microstrip antenna and non-uniform cylindrical plasmas was established to analyze the effects of different plasma distributions on the performance parameters of microstrip antenna. Results indicate that under the three electron density distributions of Gaussian, linear and exponential distribution, the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of microstrip antenna increases to different degrees, and the antenna pattern also attenuates to different degrees. The variation degree of performance parameters is related to the electron density distribution.

articleTitle: Reducing the Wrist's Effect on the Antenna Performance for Smartwatches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents the antenna designs for metal-bezel smartwatches aimed at reducing the wrist's effect. The design achieves this through two approaches: adding a metal plane and exciting the metal plane. By exciting the metal plane, a stronger vertical E-field is generated, which significantly reduces the wrist's loading effect. This new design is evaluated in both the Wi-Fi and GPS bands, indicating potential advancements in smartwatch antenna technology.

articleTitle: Bandwidth and Beamwidth Improvement of Dual-Polarized Microstrip Antenna with Compact Size
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an improved dual-polarized distributed patch antenna is proposed to achieve broadband and wide-beam performance under reduced profile condition. Firstly, the differential feeding scheme is used to excite the patches on the diagonals, and the double-layer patches are used to expand the impedance bandwidth. Hence, the additional resonance is introduced on the feeding line so as to improve the impedance matching. As such, the frequency range where the return loss of the antenna is better than -10dB is ranging from 755 to 1005MHz (28%), which can cover low-frequency 5G communication bands: n5 (824MHz-894MHz), n8 (880MHz- 960MHz), and n20 (791MHz-862MHz). Meanwhile, the antenna has achieved a half-power beamwidth (HPBW) of more than 98° in the E-plane and more than 106° in the H-plane and a reduced height of 0.04λ0.

articleTitle: A Compact Self-Decoupling Circularly Polarized Microstrip MIMO Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a compact self-decoupling circularly polarized (CP) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) antenna. The antenna unit consists of a square patch etched with a rectangular slit in the center and a rotated L-shaped feeding line (LSFL). It is found that polarization isolation of the coupled and excited CP microstrip antenna can be realizing by adjusting the size of the rectangular slit, resulting in a self-decoupling effect. The designed CP MIMO antenna with self-decoupling features exhibits a remarkably low mutual coupling of -42.7 dB and a 3-dB AR bandwidth that encompasses the L1 band of the GPS system. In addition, the antenna has the advantages of simple structure and low profile, without additional circuits and structures.

articleTitle: Multisymplectic Euler-Box scheme on Maxwell's equations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The advantages of the Multistep algorithm in Maxwell's equations have been verified by numerous scholars in the mathematical society. The Multistep Euler-box scheme is a combined format that employs both forward and backward differences simultaneously in space and time. This paper, for the first time, integrates the Multistep Euler-box scheme with practical engineering in the electromagnetic field, conducts numerical example validations, and compares it with the time-domain finite difference method, confirming the effectiveness of the Multistep Euler-box format.

articleTitle: Transient Electromagnetic Forward Modeling Method of Anisotropic Formation Based on CPML Boundary Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A large number of basic theoretical studies and field observations have shown that electrical anisotropy is universal in the Earth's interior. Considering the anisotropy of the medium in electrical exploration can help to establish a model that is more in line with the actual geological situation. In this paper, a 3D FDTD forward method for anisotropic transient electromagnetic based on CPML(Convolution PML) boundary conditions is provided, which can effectively absorb electromagnetic waves in the calculation area and avoid the generation of reflection fields. Therefore, the scale of the calculation area can be further reduced, the memory consumption can be reduced and the calculation efficiency can be improved.

articleTitle: Visual analysis of emergency robot research based on scientific knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to grasp the research trends of emergency robots in China, with 673 documents included in CNKI from 2000 to 2024 as the data source, the data visual analysis such as timing map, subject distribution, author cooperation, organization cooperation, keyword and literature co-citation, mutation word analysis and so on with the help of CiteSpace6.2. The research results show that the output of Chinese emergency robot research papers conforms to the logical growth curve of Price, and the literature output of robot, fire fighting and fire fighting is the highest, mainly published in Fire Science and Technology; Considering the publication quantity and the influence factor of the journal, Fire Science and Technology is the most authoritative core journal in the field of emergency robot in China. The author takes Jiang Shuhai, Chen Libin, Xu Zhengfei, Sun Shudong, Fei Wenliang and so on, the institutions are concentrated in Shanghai Fire Research Institute, Southwest University of Science and Technology, University of South China, Shenyang University of Technology, Nanjing Forestry University, and the author cooperation and institutional cooperation network is relatively loose. Robots, fire fighting, fire fighting and rescue, control system, high-rise building and so on are the core keywords in this field. Changing word robot, fire fighting, path planning and control system represent the hot spots and frontier of current emergency robot research

articleTitle: A Dual-Mode Substrate-Integrated Waveguide Bandpass Filter With a Square Slot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a dual-mode substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) resonator. The top surface of the resonator is etched with a square slot. By enlarging the area of the slot, the resonant frequencies of the dominant mode and the second-order mode can be brought closer together, thus designing a dual-mode SIW resonator. A two-order SIW bandpass filter (BPF) with two transmission zeros (TZ) is designed and measured. The measurement results of S-parameters are in good agreement with the simulation results, which verifies the reliability of the design idea.

articleTitle: Broadband High-Isolation Antenna for The Wide Beam Scanning of Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a low-profile two-port microstrip patch antenna (MPA) with improved bandwidth is proposed, while keeping the low mutual coupling. Firstly, the shorting pins are loaded on the shorted patch antenna (SPA) on three sides so as to gain three minimum poles for mutual coupling reduction. After that, anther shorting pins are further inserted to move these three minimum poles closely to each other, resulting in the wide isolation bandwidth with broadside-beam under two ports. Then, the ring slots are etched to improve its input impedance. Additionally, an 8-element linear array is designed and simulated. The results prove that our design antenna has successfully gained the wide bandwidth of about 16.2%, while keeping high isolation of around 20dB for the element. What's more, the designed phased array operates from 3.65 GHz to 4.27 GHz with an isolation of nearby 14.5 dB between different elements, and tit keeps a scanning angle range of -48° - +48° at 3.98 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of a novel broadband filtering antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this letter, a novel filtering patch antenna with wide bandwidth is proposed. Firstly, a short-circuited SIR feedline is used to to introduce a new resonant frequency point and generate a lower out-of-band radiation null. Then, stacked patches and parasitic patches are introduced to further expand the bandwidth while achieving a upper out-of-band radiation null. At the same time, grooves are made on both sides of the driving patch for impedance matching. Simulation results show that the proposed filtering antenna operates at 3.18 GHz and achieves a peak gain of 8.1 dBi. The relative bandwidth achieves 27% and the suppression is higher than 20.89 dB.

articleTitle: A design of horn antenna radome based on modifiable concentrated energy surface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: this paper designed a horn antenna radome using modifiable concentrated energy surface (MCES) with benefit of enhancing range of radiation pattern. Based on meta-surface theory, the MCES could operate in different modes in order to match different requirements of pattern direction. By changing the switch conditions, MCES could change the working mode easily. In addition, in order to meet the need for compact structure, MCES could be arranged at the horn antenna near field.

articleTitle: A Slim Biconical Antenna with Metasurface for Manned Lunar Rover
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a compact biconical antenna in the UHF band is presented. The antenna employs meta-surfaces coating and offset feed technologies to achieve omnidirectional torus coverage in the UHF band while meeting the installation requirements of manned lunar rovers. It has the advantages of high reliability, strong adaptability to space environment and light weight.

articleTitle: Multi-polarization leaky-wave radiation based on a Full Spoof Surface Plasmons System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the multi-polarization leaky-wave radiation based on a full spoof surface plasmons system is realized. By periodically loading spoof localized surface plasmons (SLSPs) patches on the spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) waveguide, circularly-polarized leaky-wave radiation can be achieved by exploiting the vortex wave effect of SLSPs. The proposed multi-polarized leaky-wave antenna (LWA) has two SSPPs waveguides arranged in reverse symmetry and four feeding ports. The LWA radiates left-handed circularly polarized (LHCP) waves when port 1 is fed, and a right-handed circularly polarized (RHCP) waves when port 3 is fed. Combining the two CP waves and giving different initial phase combinations can produce the multi-polarization effect, including purely linear polarizations (LP) such as x- and y-polarization. The full spoof surface plasmons system may be further extended to provide a reference scheme for polarization design for higher-frequency plasma radiation.

articleTitle: Tri-band Patch Antenna with Differential Feeding
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a differential-fed tri-band microstrip patch antenna with unidirectional radiation pattern is proposed. The proposed antenna consists of three patches, a metal strip, and four ground walls. Based on the traditional patch antenna, a pair of metal parasitic patches is added next to the middle patch antenna to excite three frequency bands and realize independent tuning of three frequency bands. The results show that the proposed antenna owns three operating bandwidths of 2.41-2.46 GHz (0.05 GHz, 2.1%), 3.48-3.54 GHz (0.06 GHz, 1.7%) and 4.61-6.06 GHz (1.45 GHz, 27.2%).

articleTitle: A GPS Antenna Protection System Loaded with Energy Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To reduce the influence of electromagnetic pulse/ high-power microwave (EMP/HPM) on GPS antenna, the bandpass energy selective surface (ESS) is loaded in front of the antenna. It can realize that the small signal can pass through with low loss, and strong electromagnetic signals can be effectively shielded in the operating band of the GPS antenna (1.56GHz-1.59GHz). In addition, loading ESS has little influence on S11, gain, axis ratio of the GPS antenna. And the shielding coefficient of the received waveform peak at the antenna port reaches 12dB, when the large signal in band is incident.

articleTitle: An Ultra-wideband Transparent Radar-Infrared Bi-Stealth Absorber
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a radar-infrared bi-stealth metamaterial absorber (MA), which consists of an infrared shielding layer (IRSL), two microwave-absorption layers (MAL) and a ground layer. The IRSL achieves infrared stealth by increasing the duty cycle of low emissivity materials. The two MALs create multiple resonances, thereby broadening the bandwidth. The absorber exhibits a wide absorption bandwidth of 10 dB from 2.75 to 18.07 GHz, covering S, C, X and Ku bands. Additionally, it demonstrates a low infrared emissivity of 0.252 from 3 to 5 and 8 to 14 mm by formula calculation. Moreover, the absorber's microwave absorption capability shows good angular stability, with a stable performance of 45 degrees for TE polarization and 60 degrees for TM polarization.

articleTitle: TAC-UNet: A Partially Dense UNet for Thermal Analysis of Chiplet-Based System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel deep learning framework called TAC-UNet is proposed for the Thermal Analysis of Chiplet-based systems. To enhance solution accuracy, the down-sampling and up-sampling modules in the TAC-UNet are designed to be partially dense. We compare the performance of TAC-UNet with other networks. The results demonstrate that the TAC-UNet can generate the temperature distribution in an extremely short inference time, with an average absolute error of 0.38 K.

articleTitle: Adaptive Maehly Approximation with Controllable Error in Scalar Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The Maehly approximation has been widely used in RCS prediction, especially in scalar domains such as frequency domain and angle domain. In this paper, the error analysis of the Maehly approximation is carried out, and an adaptive prediction scheme with controllable error is given. Firstly, the program framework is optimized for the one-dimensional (1D) Maehly approximation. Secondly, the calculation accuracy of Chebyshev polynomial and the Maehly approximation in the numerical examples of elementary function and sweep angle is compared. Finally, according to the errors of the two methods in adjacent order, the optimal method is selected adaptively. The effectiveness of the proposed method is proved by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Design of High-Power Capacity Dual-Polarized Ridged Waveguide Slot Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a high-power capacity dual-polarized slot array antenna using ridged waveguide technology is proposed. Ridged waveguide is employed to reduce the overall size of the antenna. The horizontal polarization array element is composed of 1×4 V-shaped slots, and the vertical polarization array element is composed of 1×4 longitudinal slots. A prototype of 2×5 array is simulated. The impedance bandwidths (|S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>| ≤ - 15dB) of 900 MHz and 300 MHz are achieved for horizontal and vertical polarizations, respectively. The array achieves the gain of 14.5 dBi and 15 dBi for horizontal and vertical polarizations, respectively. The power capacity of 4.1 MW and 2.8 MW are obtained for horizontal and vertical polarization array elements, respectively. The proposed antenna has the advantages of dual-polarization, high power capacity, and a compact design, which can be candidate for satellite communication.

articleTitle: Study on the interference of harmonics and intermodulation in proximity service links for 5G mobile system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an interference model for multi-hop links has been studied and analyzed. To address the performance of interference model, both harmonic and intermodulation interferences under different frequency bands are studied and calculated for the heterogeneous networks of 5G and Wi-Fi scenarios. The simulation results for system performances in multi-hop links are conducted and analyzed in conjunction with an interference station with power of 29 dBm and working frequency of 2132.5 MHz. The results of throughput and delay in the mobile system are consistent with the theorical expectations. And the interfering nodes had a relatively small impact on the overall throughput in the cell, which means that this multi-hop 5G system possess a robustness for interference.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Antenna Design for Foldable Smartphone
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the antenna is proposed to be applied to a foldable smartphone, and the parasitic antenna unit in the secondary screen is used to regulate the working performance of the main antenna unit in the main screen. The efficiency of the antenna of the folded smartphone is improved by continuously optimizing the structure of the parasitic antenna unit in the secondary screen. When the parasitic antenna unit and the main antenna unit have symmetrically positioned feed ports and ground ports, compared to the traditional parasitic branch ungrounded structure, in the folded state, the on-body total efficiency and the on-body radiation efficiency increase 5% and 10%, respectively. The -6dB bandwidth of the antenna can cover the frequency bands from 1.57 GHz to 2.05 GHz in both unfolded and folded states, which helps to improve the communication quality of the folded smartphone.

articleTitle: Time-domain Shielding Effectiveness of Cables Based on Metallized Aramid Fibers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, cables with metallized coated aramid shielding materials are prepared, and the time-domain shielding effectiveness of different structures are analyzed in comparison with those of traditional shielding cables. The results show that the time-domain shielding effectiveness inside the cable with metallization-coated aramid fibers as the shielding layer can be increased by 65% compared to the cable with traditional shielding materials. The results indicate that the metallized coated aramid material has superior shielding ability, which provides more reliable technical support for its application in the field of electromagnetic compatibility and promotes the stable operation and development of electronic equipment and communication systems.

articleTitle: A Dual-Polarization Transmission Response Switchable Frequency Selective Surface with Phase-Change Material
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A Dual-Polarization transmission response Switchable frequency selective surface (FSS) with phase-change material (PCM) is proposed in this paper. The presented FSS is composed of wideband transmission layer and switching control layer. The wire gird in bottom layer with PCM provides the switchable feature. Simulation results show that the proposed FSS can achieve the transmission coefficient is 85.4% (0.68 dB) from 8 to 12 GHz when the structure is in the conduction state. When the FSS structure is in the off state, the transmission efficiency is 5.8% (12.4 dB) from 2 GHz to 18 GHz. In addition, the FSS structure can achieves good polarization stability.

articleTitle: Research on High-Resolution Range Profile of Composite Targets in complex environment in Terahertz Band
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the advantages of terahertz band detection and recognition, combined with high frequency calculation method, are used to achieve High-Resolution Range Profile(HRRP) of composite targets in different environment. And electromagnetic scattering characteristics of composite targets are analyzed. The results show that HRRP can effectively represent shape and structure information of targets and other objects distribution on the ground. Scattering characteristics of composite targets in complex environment and imaging research is of great significance in military applications, such as detecting and identifying military targets hidden in forest vegetation. It is necessary to model composite targets in different environment and recognize targets information through simulation and imaging. The research results provide technical means and data support for targets in different ground echo detection and feature recognition.

articleTitle: Numerical Calculation and Design of Hybrid Microstrip Antenna with FSS Based on Partial Element Equivalent Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid frequency-selective surface (FSS) and ultra-wideband (UWB) microstrip antenna system with low passband loss and high out-of-band suppression is presented and calculated based on the partial element equivalent circuit (PEEC). A preliminary of microstrip antenna is designed and its radiation performance is analyzed. Then, a defected ground is introduced to extend the working bandwidth and an FSS element is used to increase out-of-band suppression. On this basic, the UWB antenna and FSS system is co-simulated and optimized by PEEC to achieve low passband loss from 5.8 to 13.2 GHz and high out-of-band suppression.

articleTitle: Broadband circularly polarized dielectric resonator antenna with branch loading
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a dielectric resonator antenna with broadband circular polarization characteristics is presented. By slotting the rectangular dielectric resonator diagonally, the length and width of the slots can be adjusted to excite the appropriate orthogonal modes to obtain circularly polarized characteristics in high frequency bands. Then by loading the upper surface copper-coated dielectric branches in the middle of the two rectangular slots to effectively reduce the value of the axial ratio in the middle band, thus integrating the two axial ratio passbands, the antenna achieves broadband circular polarization characteristics. Ultimately, the antenna obtains the impedance bandwidth of 56.6% (S11<-10dB, 2.42GHz-4.33GHz) and the axial-ratio bandwidth of 51.7% in θ=0°and ψ=0°directions (AR<3dB,2.42GHz-4.10GHz).

articleTitle: A Gradient Descent Method for Phase Only Pattern synthesis of Irregular Subarray
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The subarray method is a cost-efficient strategy for minimizing expenses in phased array systems. By grouping several elements into a subarray, the number of radio frequency (RF) chains and the overall system complexity can be decreased. However, optimizing the radiation pattern of irregular subarray continues to be a significant research challenge. A novel gradient descent method is proposed to achieve pattern synthesis for L-octomino-shaped, and skew-tetromino-shaped & L-tetromino-shaped subarray configurations on a 16×16-dimensional array. Dual-beam and flat-topped beam pattern synthesis results are presented to demonstrate that the proposed method performs effectively on the subarray configurations.

articleTitle: Design of Low-Profile Base Station Antennas by Reducing the Height of High Band Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a low-profile co-aperture base station antenna array is proposed. The antenna array consists of one low band (LB) antenna and four high band (HB) antennas, with the HB antennas positioned above the LB antenna. The LB antenna adopts a traditional frequency selective surface (FSS) loading design. To further reduce the overall height of the antenna array, a novel flexible transparent FSS film was designed, which can be directly applied to the upper surface of the HB antennas, achieving a low-profile design for the HB antennas without increasing the structural complexity. The overall height of the final antenna array is only 54 mm (0.12 λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>). Simulation results indicate that the proposed LB and HB antennas cover the frequency ranges of 0.69-0.96 GHz and 3.3-4.8 GHz, respectively. The port isolation between the LB and HB antennas exceeds 20 dB, and stable radiation patterns are observed within the operating frequency bands. The proposed antenna array offers a novel solution for the development of future 5G base station antennas.

articleTitle: Application of Ludwig Integrals to Shooting and Bouncing Ray Method for Analyzing Scattering Characteristics of Complex Targets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a shooting and bouncing ray method (SBR) based on Ludwig integrals is proposed to compute the scattering characteristics of complex targets. The method proposed in this paper uses the Ludwig integrals to compute the contribution of lit triangles in the far field after ray tracing. Because of the characteristics of the Ludwig integral, the method proposed can significantly reduce the number of ray tubes required for the calculation and the accuracy of the results is acceptable.

articleTitle: A Novel Broadband Microstrip Array Antenna with Beam Tilt
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The array antenna is fed by a six-way stripline network, which consists of a equal Wilkinson power divider(PD) and four unequal PDs. The coupling between the patch elements and the feed network is realized by using metalized via. A 6×6 array antenna has been fabricated and measured. The measured results are in good agreement with the simulated values, which show that the proposed antenna has a impedance bandwidth of about 12.89% for |S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>|<-10dB. The sidelobe levels (SLL) in E-plane and H-plane of the antenna are less than -12dB and -15dB, respectively. Moreover, stable radiation patterns with beam tilt of 40°and a peak gain of 13.21–16.82dBi are achieved within the operating band. The proposed antenna has a broad bandwidth, low back-radiation level, and low fabrication cost.

articleTitle: A Broadband Circularly Polarized Antenna with Top-Loaded Artificial Dielectric Layers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A miniaturised broadband circularly polarized antenna working at Ka-band is proposed. The circular polarization of the antenna is achieved well by feeding the signal through two orthogonal probes. The broadband impedance transformation of the antenna is realised with free space through artificial dielectric layers (ADLs) loaded on the top, thus broadening the bandwidth of the antenna. The simulation results show that the impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 26.94 GHz37.55 GHz with a relative bandwidth of 33.41%, and the axial ratios within the bandwidth are all less than 3 dB. Meanwhile, an 8 × 8 array is formed by means of rotating feed, and the impedance bandwidth of the cells in the array is 29.87 GHz-38.85 GHz with a relative bandwidth of 26.13%. The above results have shown that this broadband circularly polarized antenna with an artificial dielectric layer carried on top has good application prospects in the field of communication.

articleTitle: Analyzing the RCS of Biaxial Anisotropic Media
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An efficient method for analyzing the electromagnetic(EM) scattering behavior of the biaxial anisotropic media in monostatic radar. The electromagnetic scattering characteristics of the anisotropic media are described in tensor permittivity, which can increase the difficulty of calculation, and reflection coefficient is included in the efficient calculation of radar cross section (RCS). Therefore, the relationship between electric and magnetic fields in anisotropic media is obtained by substituting the tensor permittivity into Maxwell equation. The reflection coefficients are calculated using the spectral domain method (SDM) and the saddle point evaluation (SPE). Then the electromagnetic scattering field is analyzed through the physical optics (PO) method. In order to verify the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed algorithm in this paper, the results of the proposed method are compared with the numerical reference solution in detail.

articleTitle: A Novel Low-Profile Dual-polarized Planar Array Antenna Using Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel low profile dual-polarized high gain microstrip array antenna based on metasurface. It is composed of a top metasurface, bottom metallic ground plane, and two microstrip antennas with orthogonal polarizations, which combines the functionalities of both folded transmitarray and Febry-Perot resonant cavity antenna. Owning the appealing features of high gain, low profile, simple structure and dual polarized operation, our designed antenna will be a promising candidate in the future communication systems.

articleTitle: Conformal Mapping Based Dispersion Characterization of Radial Slow Wave Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The design of vacuum electron devices (VEDs), such as backward wave oscillators (BWO) and traveling wave tubes (TWT), relies on correctly modeling the dispersion characteristics of their Slow Wave Structures (SWS). Traditional axial structure theories do not apply to radial-line devices due to differences in coordinate systems. This study uses conformal mapping to transform rectangular radial grating SWS into their axial counterparts, allowing modified dispersion equations to calculate dispersion curves. The radial and azimuthal components of the radial SWS are transformed, while the axial component remains unchanged. The electromagnetic field distribution in radial SWS is similar to that in a planar groove with a metal plate, enabling the use of equivalent dispersion equations on mapped SWS. The periodicity of each transformed period changes logarithmically, requiring the dispersion equation to be applied for each period, with the average dispersion curve obtained by averaging individual curves. The dispersion curve for W-band frequencies is plotted with parameters: period p = 0.71 mm, groove height h = 0.41 mm, grating width d = 0.50 mm, and beam channel height s = 0.78 mm. This methodology provides a framework for accurately predicting the dispersion characteristics of radial SWS, enhancing the design of advanced VEDs.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Emergency Communication Research Based on Scientific Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Emergency communication is an important component of the emergency system and one of the key infrastructures for national emergency support, playing an increasingly important role in emergency management. This paper takes 1525 articles collected by CNKI from 2003 to 2023 as the data source, and with the help of CiteSpace6.2, conducts visual analysis on research topics, author cooperation, institutional cooperation, keywords, burst words, and time-series maps. The research results show that China's research on the field of "emergency communication" mainly focuses on emergency communication systems, emergency communication support, satellite communication, emergency communication networks, emergency communication technology, electric power emergency communication, railway emergency communication, unmanned aerial vehicles, and command systems, etc. The core authors are Wang Haitao, Chen Libin, Xu Zhengfei, Sun Shudong, Fei Wenliang, etc., and the research institutions are concentrated in Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, PLA University of Science and Technology School of Communications Engineering, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, China Electronics Technology Group Corporation No.54 Research Institute, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Telecommunication Research Institute Communication Standards Research Institute, etc. Both author collaboration and institutional cooperation network are relatively loose. The core keywords in the research field include "emergency communication", "satellite communication", "application", "firefighting", "UAV", "shortwave communication", "emergency", "railway", "communication technology", "emergency events", with research hotspots focusing on "UAV", "firefighting rescue", "firefighting", "application", "satellite".
